status: PROTOTYPE. Item names follow the NASA HRP countermeasures the team extracted from the Hazards videos and pages (names not verified by Claude against the pages). MET values are team simulation assumptions. The LLM may only choose exercise_id from this list; code computes every number. 'PROTOCOL' items are not exercise: they carry no dosing or settings in this app and must be directed by a flight surgeon where requires_flight_surgeon_direction is true.

items.label: ARED resistive loading, moderate (or bands)
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: fitness and exercise protocols; spine and hip bone loss of ~1-1.5% per month in microgravity

items.label: ARED resistive loading, vigorous
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: fitness and exercise protocols (ISS crews exercise ~2 h/day)

items.label: Treadmill with harness, brisk walk or jog
Zero T2 treadmill-free compact ergometer and resistive session
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: compact exercise for smaller Moon and Mars spacecraft

items.label: Stretching and mobility
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: spine elongation (height can increase by up to ~3%)

items.label: Veno-constrictive thigh cuff and B-complex protocol (vision / SANS)
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: SANS countermeasures. Cuff settings and any supplement amounts must come from the flight surgeon, never from this app.

items.label: Lower-body compression and fluid loading (before landing or surface work)
items.nasa_basis: HRP Gravity: low blood pressure and fainting on landing. Fluid amounts must come from the flight surgeon.

items.label: Circadian LED lighting and crew journaling session
items.nasa_basis: HRP Isolation: Earth-simulating LED lighting for circadian alignment; crew journaling as a safe place to vent frustration

items.label: Habitat microbial surface swab and air check
items.nasa_basis: HRP Hostile/Closed Environments: spacecraft microbial surface swabbing; habitability factor 'Air'
